invariants.rationale: It is reasonable to expect width to be positive for a layer in a tiled map.
It is reasonable to expect height to be positive for a layer in a tiled map.
The caller is expected to provide a non-null JsonValue element for proper deserialization.
The total number of tiles in the layer (width * height) should be greater than zero.
The element parameter likely represents an object node in the map's JSON.
